headlines.title: ‘반도체 추가세수’ 수십조 미래대응기금 …다음주 청사진 나온다
headlines.summary: 기금 규모·활용처 관심 관람객이 전시된 반도체 웨이퍼를 바라보고 있다. 연합뉴스 청와대가 반도체 호황에 따른 추가세수를 바탕으로 한 미래대응기금을 신설하기로 하면서, 구체적인 기금 규모 및 활용처에 대한 관심이 쏠린다. 정부가 미래 성장과 양극화, 청년 지원 등 넓은 지출 분야에 쓰기로 밝힌 터라, 지출의 칸막이가 필요하다는 지적도 나온다.

headlines.title: 추경 편성 없이 미래대응기금 활용 포석 [3대 메가프로젝트 속도전]
headlines.summary: ‘초과→추가 세수’로 용어 변경 이유 초과 세수, 세출 추가 땐 추경 필요 정부 세수 예측 실패 전제도 회피 野 “국가 재정을 ‘정권 쌈짓돈’으로” 정부가 미래대응기금 신설 추진 방침을 밝히면서 그간 써왔던 ‘초과세수’ 대신 ‘추가세수’로 용어를 바꾼 배경에 관심이 쏠린다.

headlines.title: 올 추가세수 50조, 미래기금 투입하려면 법 고쳐야
headlines.summary: '추가세수 활용' 주요 쟁점은 법 적용 아닌 상황, 산정방식 모호 내년부터 집행시 올해 추경 불필요 "사회안전망 강화에도 재원 투입해야" [세종=이데일리 서대웅 하상렬 기자] 정부가 추가세수를 ‘미래대응기금’에 적립해 3대 메가프로젝트 등의 투자 재원으로 활용하겠다고 공식화하며 무엇을 추가세수로 볼 것인지가 최대 쟁점으로 떠올랐다.

headlines.title: 복지도 산업도 세액공제 대신 보조금 으로?···청년·저소득층 혜택 늘...
headlines.summary: 이재명 대통령이 이준헌 기자 혼인 세액공제 등 복지정책은 물론 국내 생산촉진세제 등 산업정책에서도 세금을 깎아주는 대신 보조금 등을 지급하는 방안이 거론되고 있다. 보조금 형태로 지원 방식이 바뀌면 청년·저소득층으로선 혜택이 커질 수 있을 것으로 기대된다. 다만, 예상치 못한 부작용이 발생할 수 있는 만큼 점진적인 전환이 필요하다는 제언이 나온다.

headlines.title: 전월세 폭등에 버거워진 서울살이 … 청년들 경기도로 밀려나

headlines.title: 전국 휘발유값 석달 만에 1800원대로

key_headlines.title: Government to Establish Future Response Fund Using Semiconductor Tax Surplus
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's government plans to create a future response fund backed by additional tax revenue from semiconductor boom, with specific fund size and usage details to be unveiled next week amid concerns about spending allocation across multiple sectors.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Residents Migrate to Gyeonggi Province Due to Soaring Jeonse/Monthly Rent Prices
key_headlines.summary: Rising jeonse and monthly rent burdens in Seoul are forcing young people and non-homeowners to relocate to Gyeonggi Province, with Seoul experiencing its highest jeonse shortage in five and a half years.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Plunges 4.9% to 7,600 Level Amid Market Volatility
key_headlines.summary: The Korean stock market experienced extreme volatility with KOSPI falling nearly 5% to the 7,600 level, triggering the circuit breaker system for the 16th time this year, attributed partly to single-stock leverage ETFs.

key_headlines.title: Korea to Launch 24-Hour Currency Trading to Support Won Internationalization
key_headlines.summary: South Korea has implemented round-the-clock won trading from Monday 6 AM to Saturday 6 AM, enabling corporations and individuals to better manage foreign exchange risks and enhance won internationalization.

key_headlines.title: Consumer Price Index Revised to Include ChatGPT, Mara Tang; Excludes Peanuts, Dashcam
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's consumer price index will be restructured to reflect changing consumer patterns, adding items like AI subscriptions, mara tang, and smart watches while removing traditional items like peanuts and dashcams.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's government has announced plans to create a future response fund utilizing an estimated 50 trillion won in additional tax revenue from semiconductor prosperity, with detailed fund structure and allocation plans expected next week. The government faces key challenges in defining what constitutes additional revenue and determining appropriate spending channels. Rising jeonse and monthly rent prices in Seoul have become unsustainable for young people and non-homeowners, prompting significant migration to Gyeonggi Province and surrounding areas. Seoul's jeonse shortage has reached a five-and-a-half year high, with price increases five times higher than last year. Additionally, South Korea has launched 24-hour currency trading to support won internationalization and facilitate corporate hedge risk management.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government faces debate over how to define and allocate the 50 trillion won in additional tax revenue, with legal framework adjustments necessary for the proposed future response fund. The additional tax collection will reduce the government's borrowing from the Bank of Korea to a four-year low in the first half of 2026, with only 44.1 trillion won borrowed from January to June. Consumer price index has been revised to reflect evolving consumption patterns, adding 10 new items including ChatGPT subscriptions, mara tang, and smart watches while removing traditional items. Core inflation remains at 2.5% and household inflation expectations continue at 2.8%, keeping inflation monitoring a key policy concern ahead of the monetary policy committee decision.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI experienced severe volatility, plunging 4.9% to the 7,600 level with the circuit breaker triggered for the 16th time in 2026, largely attributed to single-stock leverage ETFs concentrated in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. Liquidity concentration in the stock market has disrupted the balance between interest rates, exchange rates, and banking sector finances, with concerns that semiconductor-driven market movements could push policy rate increases. Won-dollar exchange rate strengthened to 1,528.2 won per dollar as foreign investors reduced bond holdings, while three-year government bond yields rose to 3.780% annually. Bond market movements are increasingly influenced by stock and foreign exchange market volatility, reflecting systemic interconnectedness in financial markets.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korea's manufacturing sector is experiencing a renaissance with recognition of semiconductors, batteries, shipbuilding, defense, and nuclear power as strategic national assets, supported by government policy financing. Global supply chain restructuring is shifting production away from China-centric efficiency models toward strategic alliances with the United States and Europe, favoring Korea's advanced manufacturing capabilities. Data center and energy infrastructure demand is surging, with Korean companies planning integrated packages combining data center construction with power supply and energy infrastructure for export. Korea's nuclear reactor exports are gaining attention as a non-Russian alternative, while battery, EV, solar, and wind technologies now serve as critical energy infrastructure for AI and advanced computing operations.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul is experiencing unprecedented jeonse market volatility with apartment prices rising sharply as landlords convert jeonse contracts to monthly rentals, forcing tenants to relocate to surrounding provinces. Property tax compliance efforts have identified 731 million won in evasion among 104 suspects, addressing issues such as single-property status fraud and unreported income. The abolishment of the 35-floor height restriction has triggered competition among apartment complexes seeking super-tall redevelopment status, raising concerns about construction delays and landscape preservation. Nationwide apartment jeonse rates have risen for 10 consecutive months, with developers offering financial incentives such as fixed deposit structures and interest-free interim payments in high-rate regions like Gimhae, Yangsan, Suwon, and Yangju.
sections.International Economy: U.S. stock markets reached record highs with Dow Jones surpassing 53,000 points for the first time, driven by AI semiconductor gains and positive earnings reports from Broadcom and AMD. The Federal Reserve's June FOMC meeting minutes are scheduled for release on July 8th, expected to clarify the central bank's interest rate trajectory under new Fed Chair Kevin Wash. Walmart announced significant price reductions, including 50% cuts on cherries and 33% reductions on cola, potentially supporting inflation reduction efforts and consumer spending. The Fed continues to monitor inflation above its 2% target due to supply shocks, while major economic events including Samsung and SK Hynix earnings and SK Hynix ADR Nasdaq trading debut will determine near-term market direction.
sections.AI & Economy: Nobel Prize-winning economist Pisaridis forecasts that the era of high economic growth cannot be restored even with AI advancement, with 40% of jobs remaining outside AI's impact zone. South Korea faces a paradox as an AI leader, with jobs for those aged 50 and above growing by over 200,000 in the past three years while youth employment has declined by approximately 210,000 positions, particularly in programming and IT-related fields. China's advanced technology sector, including physical AI and fintech, is rapidly expanding with first-quarter exports surging 210% year-over-year, driven by mature robotics ecosystems and cost control advantages. Technology executives have reversed earlier positions on AI eliminating employment, acknowledging that human workers remain critical despite AI adoption, with historical analysis showing 85% of jobs created over 80 years resulted from technological advancement.
sections.Others: South Korea's ruling party is proposing a new youth special fund similar to the regional depopulation response fund to address youth employment and economic challenges. China is experiencing rapid growth in gig economy workers, with 300 million temporary workers including high-degree holders like PhD holders working as delivery personnel due to prolonged property recession and structural industrial adjustment. Single-stock leverage ETFs have become problematic, with accounts showing significant losses and investors questioning whether they can recover their principal investments, prompting government review of regulatory improvements. The government is implementing measures to address concerns about leverage ETF market volatility while maintaining economic support for vulnerable populations through strengthened social safety nets.
